name: Mii de Cranach
original_name: ミィー・ド・クラナッハ
source:
She is a young lady who lives comfortably in a prestigious family. Although she is highly educated, she doesn't have any hobbies, and is always bored. She doesn't like playboys, so she refuses everything and has never dated a man.

[Edited from [url=http://www.masterup.net/hina-soft/moe_hina/majyokko/index.html]Official site[/url]]
